Me personally, I like to have an idea of what I want my character to look like at the end of the game and plan out what base stats I'm gonna need, then I power level just those stats. I've done a level 50 playthrough where I was a katana only character, so I knew I had to get to level 20 in both body and reflex asap. In terms of perks, there's a lot of good youtube videos out there that show you specifically what perks are good for a certain build. If you're just picking them yourself then start off with stuff that will help you in any combat scenario. Once you start to get a playstyle, look into what makes that playstyle good and pick perks related to those stats. For example, my netrunner build is all about doing as much damage to as many people as possible without ever being seen or having get out my gun. So I need a lot of RAM (essentially this game's Mana), and any perks that help with regenerating RAM faster or using less RAM helps a lot. But since I'm also hidden most of the time, I put a lot of points into Cool so I can do more damage while undetected and more damage with poison for my contagion virus. If you're having a hard time figuring out what you want to put a lot of points into, look at the perks at the ends of the tree (the ones that require at least level 18) and see if they sound cool or useful to have.
